crossRefs.note: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

parallels.note: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them…

translations.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
translations.asv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
